name: Text field
summary: One line or several lines of text, with a label inside the filled box, a hint and an error.

anatomy.description: Always visible: inside the box, top left, while typing too.
Format or purpose, linked with aria-describedby.
An icon and a sentence after the hint; the box border turns danger and thickens.
Visible and in the label text.

variants.description: input of type text, email, tel, url, search.
A search box in a list's toolbar : the control height, the smaller radius, no fill; the label may be visually hidden inside a search landmark.

cues.invalid: Thicker danger border, an icon and a written error; aria-invalid. The border also follows :user-invalid, after the person edits a field with a native constraint or tries to submit.

keyboard.action: Moves to and from the field.

a11y.name: The label element.
notes: Errors are announced through the error summary and linked to their field.
A text area grows with its content up to twenty lines (field-sizing), then scrolls; it can still be resized.

platforms.ios: TextField / TextEditor with a label above
